note: Snapshot of the AWS prices that docs/cost-model.md uses, read from the AWS Price List API (GetProducts, us-east-1, on-demand) on 2026-10-09. Model token prices are not here: they live in config/models.yaml, from the same source. Prices change; regenerate before relying on them.

lambda_gb_second_arm.unit: USD per GB-second, by monthly GB-seconds

apigw_http_request.unit: USD per request, by monthly requests

dynamodb_write_request_unit.unit: USD per write request unit, on demand

dynamodb_read_request_unit.unit: USD per read request unit, on demand

cloudwatch_metric_month.unit: USD per custom metric per month

cloudwatch_logs_ingest_gb.unit: USD per GB ingested, standard class

vpc_interface_endpoint_hour.unit: USD per endpoint per hour (one subnet)

vpc_interface_endpoint_gb.unit: USD per GB processed, first petabyte
